high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "thecosmicyou." The post features a black background with white text and an illustration at the bottom. The text reads: "The sun is conscious. We already know this, hence why from a young age, we drew the sun with a smiley face. All ancient cultures believed the sun was a conscious entity, and more than just matter. This is fairly easy to fathom when it is widely known and accepted that the Earth 'Mother Nature' is too, a living organism which is conscious. IG: CONNECTINGCONSCIOUSNESS" Below
